Overlay now shows a Transcribing… pill (spinner + label, matching accent aesthetic) during the gap between a successful stop command and the transcription result. Key discovery: the sidecar transcribes synchronously in its recording thread and emits TranscriptionReady BEFORE RecordingStopped (RecordingStopped is the final event of every pipeline, incl. too-short/no-speech recordings), so the transcribing phase cannot be derived from sidecar events. Instead, a new onCommandResponse hook in sidecar.ts lets the main process detect successful stop_recording / toggle_recording(recording:false) responses — covering all stop paths (tray, global shortcut, UI button, Linux hotkey via HotkeyTriggered→toggle_recording) — and pushes 'overlay:status: transcribing' to the overlay window. OverlayPage hides on RecordingStopped/TranscriptionReady/Error; createCanario hides the overlay window on TranscriptionReady/RecordingStopped/Error (no longer on stop). Tray race fixed: the 2s transcribing→idle setTimeout is now a cancellable module-level timer superseded by any newer tray state. typecheck+build pass.

Overlay window is repositioned/resized onto the display containing the cursor every time it is shown: positionOverlayWindow() uses screen.getDisplayNearestPoint(screen.getCursorScreenPoint()) and setBounds(display.bounds), called from the overlay:show IPC handler; initial creation also uses the primary display's full bounds (x/y included) instead of workAreaSize at 0,0. typecheck+build pass.

Electron host failure paths hardened. Crash visibility: the sidecar exit handler distinguishes crash from deliberate stop (stopSidecar nulls the handle first) and on crash emits a synthetic renderer-visible {event:'SidecarCrashed', code} through the normal event channel; createCanario translates it to a new SIDECAR_CRASHED machine event that forces recording/transcribing/downloading back to idle (no zombie recording state, no forever-visible overlay — api.hideOverlay fires), sets lastError which auto-toasts 'restart Canario', and main resets the tray to idle + marks the tooltip '⚠ backend offline' (new setTrayOffline). Fail-fast: in-flight commands are tracked and all rejected immediately on exit/spawn-error ('Sidecar exited (code N)') instead of hanging to the 10s timeout; post-crash commands reject 'Sidecar crashed — restart Canario' via new getSidecarStatus(). Startup: spawn 'error' (ENOENT etc.) rejects the init ping immediately (no 5s hang) and the whenReady chain gained a .catch showing dialog.showErrorBox + app.exit(1) — no more invisible dead app. Streams: stdin/stdout/stderr error handlers attached (async EPIPE can no longer become an uncaught exception); the sync write in sendCommand is also wrapped. Tests: 5 new sidecar.test.ts cases (running-after-pong, crash→synthetic event + pending fail-fast + fail-closed commands, deliberate stop not a crash, spawn-failure fast reject, EPIPE handled) + 4 machine.test.ts SIDECAR_CRASHED transitions incl. signal-notifying idle self-transition; 179 vitest passing, typecheck clean. Supervised respawn with backoff (optional item 4) deliberately not done — filed as follow-up consideration in the epic if ever needed.

Lifecycle fully exposed and reconciled. Protocol: new commands cancel_recording (discard in-flight audio, no transcription/paste/history; emits RecordingCancelled; no-op safe idle), cancel_download (requests cancellation; ModelDownloadFailed follows; .part files kept for resume), is_downloading (authoritative in-flight query), and status returning new core type LifecycleStatus {recording, transcribing, downloading} (transcribing derived from RecordingHandle::is_busy; exported from canario-core). Renderer: createCanario queries status on mount and sends a new STATUS_SYNC machine event — a shared syncFromStatus transition maps core truth directly onto the machine from ANY status (fixes the reload desync where machine=idle vs core=recording persisted silently for a whole recording); overlay restored when core is mid-recording. UI: ✕ cancel button beside the Record stop button (AppPage), Cancel button beside download progress in both AppPage and OnboardingPage (cancel_download + toast; machine returns via the existing ModelDownloadFailed→DOWNLOAD_FAILED path). PRD Appendix A documents all four commands.
